test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: To pack a set of books, Surbhi made a carton that was 48 inches long, 27 inches wide and 30 inches tall. What will be the total surface area (in square feet) of this carton, once it closed from all sides? [Use 1 foot = 12 inches]
solution:
**Given:**

Length (L) = 48 inches = 4 feet

Breadth (B) = 27 inches = 2.25 feet

Height (H) = 30 inches = 2.5 feet

**Formula used:**

The surface area of cuboid = 2 × [(L × B) + (B × H) + (H × L)]

**Calculation:**

The surface area of cuboid = 2 × [(L × B) + (B × H) + (H × L)]

⇒ 2 × [(4 × 2.25) + (2.25 × 2.5) + (2.5 × 4)]

⇒ 2 × [9 + 5.625 + 10]

⇒ 2 × 24.625 = 49.25 feet²

**∴ The correct answer is 49.25 feet2.**
